title: macrosynth

content: A module based on Mutable Instrument’s Plaits, using this PD external port by Javier Nonis: https://github.com/jnonis/pd-plaits This module allows direct access to all parameter without any external processing or envelopes. If 'Trigger' is on the internal envelope is used, if not the last note will continue to sound after it is released. To install, unzip and copy the archive directory into ORAC's usermodules/synth folder (/media/orac/usermodules/synth/ on Organelle). More information on modes and parameters be found in the Plaits manual: https://mutable-instruments.net/modules/plaits/manual/ Image by cocoparisienne from Pixabay
